# Monvera

> Monvera is a mobile-first app for investing in real companies through tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain, guided by Vera, an AI broker. You describe a goal in plain words; Vera turns it into a portfolio of tokenized shares and places it in one tap.

Monvera is built for people who are new to investing and to crypto. There is no seed phrase and no gas: you sign in with email, and Monvera covers the fees. Holdings are real tokenized shares, held in self-custody and recorded on-chain, with settlement in USDG (Global Dollar). Because every action is signed on-chain, your track record can't be edited.

## Key facts

- Invest by describing a goal in plain language to Vera, an AI broker.
- Buy fractional, tokenized shares of well-known global companies (for example NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, GOOGL, META, and the S&P 500 via SPY).
- Email login — no seed phrase, no browser extension, no manual wallet setup.
- Gasless, with fees on us: no gas costs and no account fees.
- Real shares: tokenized 1:1, held in self-custody, recorded on-chain.
- Trades are raced across every live venue on Robinhood Chain (LiFi, Uniswap V4, KyberSwap) and filled wherever the price is best, settling atomically in one sponsored transaction.
- Autopilot: optional automated, recurring investing (dollar-cost averaging).
- Open strategies: rule-based portfolios published with methods, weights, and honest walk-forward backtests (no look-ahead), free to reproduce or build on.
- Built on Robinhood Chain, a fast, low-cost Ethereum L2. You can start from as little as $1.
- Not available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland.

## Pages

- [Open the app](https://monvera.best/app): the live product.
